Alawar hid his treasure in a vault guarded by minotaurs and magic fields, beneath the island of Senja, north of Carlin. There are two routes: the short one, through Senja castle, gives 3 {item:White Pearl|White Pearls} and a {item:Broadsword}; the long one, through the Folda caves, gives all the rewards, including a {item:Dark Helmet} and three keys.
Alawar has hidden his treasure, guarded by his fierce minotaurs and dangerous magic fields.
Needs neither Premium nor a minimum level (25 recommended).
For the full rewards via the short route: already have the {item:Key 4502}.
At least 20 gp for the trip
if you already have it (long route)
if you already have it, or on the short route for the full rewards
Short route (Senja): only 3 White Pearls and the Broadsword, unless you already have Key 4502.
Long route (Folda): gives all the rewards, including Key 4503. It does not need Key 4502, but if you already have it, bring it, otherwise you may get stuck.
Rewards: 3 {item:White Pearl|White Pearls} and a {item:Broadsword}. With the {item:Key 4502} you can also do the long route in reverse for the rest of the rewards.
Take the raft **north of Carlin** to **Senja** (20 gp). Talk to the boatman {npc:Nielson}: {key:hi}, {key:senja}, {key:yes}. You land on {npc:Anderson}'s raft, in the **west** of Senja.
Cross the fields to the far **west**. There is a lever hidden under fire. Use a {item:Destroy Field Rune} on the fire to reveal the {item:Lever|lever}.
The lever hidden under the fire
Pull the lever: it disappears and the magic walls to the **north** disappear too.
Enter the {item:Magic Forcefield} to get to {wiki:Alawar's Vault}.
Watch out for the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and a {creature:Minotaur Mage}: if the door is not locked, they can get to you.
Open the **2 chests** next to the teleport to receive the reward.
Alawar's Vault: open the chests next to the teleport to receive the reward

Step on the teleport again: you appear at the top of the castle. If you brought the {item:Key 4502}, do the long route (below) in reverse instead to receive the rest of the rewards ({item:Dark Helmet}, 4 {item:Throwing Knife|Throwing Knives}, {item:Blank Rune}, 33 gp and the {item:Key 4502}). To return to the mainland, go down from the castle and go to {npc:Anderson}'s raft in the **west** of Senja: {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes} (the trip back is free). You arrive at the raft north of Carlin.
Gives all the rewards, including the {item:Key 4503}. There are several routes; this is the fastest.

Take the boat **north of Carlin** to **Folda** (20 gp) and enter the Folda caves. Talk to the boatman {npc:Nielson}: {key:hi}, {key:folda}, {key:yes}. You land at the Folda dock, next to {npc:Svenson}.
From the start of the cave, head **southwest** until you reach a room with {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. Whenever you can't go southwest, go **southeast**. Alternatively, follow the map.

Fastest route: follow the dark green lines to the chest with Key 4503, go back to the light green line and follow it to the protected area (opens with Key 4503); at the end of the line use the Pick on the fire
Go **west** and open the chest in the western room to get the {item:Key 4503}.
Go back and find the *protected area* (locked door). Open it with the {item:Key 4503} and continue to the fire fields.
Open the hole with the Pick
Use the {item:Pick} on the fire field against the wall, **between the piles of rocks**. A hole opens.
Go down the hole. You fall **two floors**; the second one is just 1 sqm with another hole.
There is no way back! The only way out of here is to complete the quest.
The entrance to Alawar's cave (the hole)

Follow the path to get the {item:Key 4501} and the {item:Key 4502} and continue to {wiki:Alawar's Vault}. The remaining rewards ({item:Dark Helmet}, 4 {item:Throwing Knife|Throwing Knives}, a {item:Blank Rune} and 33 gp) are on this route: that is why, on the short route, you can only get them if you already have Key 4502.
Follow the green line to pick up Key 4501 and Key 4502 and continue to Alawar's Vault

In the vault, open the **2 chests** next to the teleport (3 {item:White Pearl|White Pearls} and {item:Broadsword}). Leave through the teleport, which drops you at the top of Senja castle. To return to the mainland, go down from the castle and talk to {npc:Anderson}, on the raft in the **west** of Senja: {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes} (free).

Dangers along the quest: {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls}, {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Bug|Bugs}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and minotaurs of all kinds ({creature:Minotaur Archer|Archers}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Guards}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Mages}).
